headline: MapQuest adds layer showing locations of Flock surveillance cameras
summary: MapQuest launched a feature that shows where Flock surveillance cameras are located. One outlet notes the feature could help users avoid Flock and other automatic license plate reader cameras.

claims.statement: MapQuest added a feature showing the locations of Flock surveillance cameras.
